visual_description: A large, thick silver-and-brown woven tarp draped over an uneven mound (the fossil pedestal). The edges of the tarp are held down by six olive-drab canvas sandbags. This represents the site being 'put to bed' for the evening or to wait out a storm.

constraints.texture: Woven plastic 'poly-tarp' texture; heavy canvas texture for sandbags.
